checks.name: Period recovery
checks.detail: no repeat of the transit in 314 days of TESS data (nothing of its depth above 7.0σ); most probable P ≈ 596 d (68%: 269-1270 d), from the periods the data allow and the transit probability; a second transit fixes it: the next TESS sectors of the star, or ground photometry
checks.value: 16 sectors scanned (314 d) · ZTF not used: the star (G 12.0) saturates it · ATLAS not used (needs an ATLAS_API_TOKEN) · 3984 ASAS-SN points over 11.1 yr · 24% of 10.9-2000 d allowed by the TESS coverage, ASAS-SN rules out 1% of those

checks.name: Engineering data
